test_title: PYST 30: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The child broke many toys in the shop. He even threw the paintings.

options.text: Many toys in the shop have been broken by the child. Even the paintings were thrown by him.
Many toys in the shop were broken by the child. Even the paintings have been thrown by him.
Many toys in the shop were broken by the child. Even the paintings were thrown by him.
Many toys in the shop were broken by the child. He has even thrown the paintings.

solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'Many toys in the shop were broken by the child. Even the paintings were thrown by him.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the active voice. We have to change the sentence into passive form. 
 
• The given sentence is written in 'simple past tense.'
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Subject + V2 + Object.
 
• Passive Voice: Object + was/were + V3 + by (
